integrity: The new assertion is the exact L-polynomial and explicit unpolarized genus-two square isogeny. The genus, 3-rank and minimal geometric automorphism group of the originating curve are credited to the source. Arithmetic finite-field enumerations are exact and replayable; the full zeta determination additionally uses the genus-four Weil functional equation.
scientific_limitations: A result for the particular F3-models; no explicit isogeny morphism, kernel or polarization compatibility, no absolute simplicity claim, and no generalization to every Artin–Schreier curve.
title: A genus-four Artin–Schreier Jacobian is isogenous to the square of an explicit simple genus-two Jacobian
